```{r, echo = F}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo =F, message = F, warning = F)
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyverse)
df <- readRDS("./combined.Rds")
df <- df %>%
  mutate(uniq_pec = uniq/converge_n)
```

### Introduction
```{r}
df %>% group_by(k,nclass) %>%
  filter(me == "high me") %>%
  summarise(maxismode = mean(maxismode,na.rm = T),
            converge = round(mean(converge_n,na.rm = T)/500,2)) %>%
  arrange(nclass)
  
  df %>% group_by(k,nclass) %>%
  filter(me == "low me") %>%
  summarise(maxismode = mean(maxismode,na.rm = T),
            converge = round(mean(converge_n,na.rm = T)/500,2)) %>%
    arrange(nclass)
```
